title: Kicky Crisp Slovakian Broccoli Wrap
description: A salty and crisp Slovakian dish featuring purple sprouting broccoli in a ssam wrap, low in fat for a healthy and energizing meal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, toss the broccoli florets with olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the broccoli mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 15 minutes.
While the broccoli is roasting, prepare the ssam wraps by laying them flat on a clean surface.
Once the broccoli is done, let it cool for a few minutes before spooning it onto the center of each ssam wrap.
Sprinkle crumbly feta cheese over the broccoli on each wrap.
Drizzle a tablespoon of lemon juice over the broccoli and feta cheese on each wrap.
Fold the bottom half of each ssam wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly to form a neat package.
